acceptable.pattern: red nail polish|manicure|nail polish|painted nails|puffer vest|quilted vest|gilet|down vest|grey (shirt|sweater)|black (sleeve|sweater|coat)
shallow depth of field|bokeh|out of focus|soft focus|dry grass|tall grass|meadow|field|autumn|fall|golden hour|outdoors

forbidden.why: an occasion or relationship inferred about real people from a ring and a gesture
no maker's mark or logo is visible
the watermark names a website, not a person's role or the photo's purpose
physical or age descriptors of a person
height of a person (scoped to people)

notes: Shallow depth of field outdoors in dry autumn grass: a sharp hand with dark red nail polish and a ring, raised toward the camera from a black sleeve at right; a defocused man in a dark quilted vest over a grey shirt stands at left. Watermark '© www.better-digital-photo-tips.com' bottom right. ADVERSARIAL for occasion and relationship inference ('engagement', 'proposal', 'couple'): only the ring, the clothes and the setting may be named. Usable: the subject (the hand and ring) is sharp; the blur is intentional background defocus.
